Dialogue_Text: So you're a mage? I knew a mage once but he was pretty stuffy. You're not like that.
Stuffy mage? Who was this mage?
Thanks for saying that. Lets go.
Yes you're not stuffy at all like this mage I knew. I'll tell you about him.

This mage was named Archibald, an unhappy gnome. He never smiled and never told jokes. He would get up every day at the same time. He would do pretty much the same thing every day and never leave his mage tower. He even scared off little kids if they got too close to his tower. Stuffy he was!
So because he did not smile or told jokes he was stuffy?
Interesting I am sure. I think you misjudge me because I am stuffy and do not want to talk about this any more.

Why yes silly! People need to lighten up once in a while and cut loose! If you are serious all the time people will shy away from you. They will think you are meany or sumthin. Plus it's good for your soul. A happy person is a happy soul!
Me thinks someone has had too much black lotus. We really need to get going.
Interesting Alora. Umm yeah lets get going.
A interesting philosophy you have Alora.
Really? Hmmm no you're not! Quit pulling my leg, <CHARNAME>. You're not stuffy, you just joked with me now. Any how, we should get going like you said. There is plenty to get done!
Okay, <CHARNAME>, maybe we will talk about this later.
It sure is, <CHARNAME>! Live it, spread it and spread the love around with a smile!
